air.label: Air (~16GB)
air.notes: Prefer 7b VLM; fall back to 3b if VRAM/RAM pressure.
air.whisper_notes: base.en (~142 MB) keeps RAM free for the 7b VLM on 16 GB; small.en (~466 MB) is more accurate if RAM allows.

pro.label: Pro (~64GB)
pro.notes: Default qwen2.5vl:7b for speed (~1 min/clip); qwen2.5vl:32b (~21 GB, ~4 min/clip) is installed for higher-quality descriptions.
pro.whisper_notes: large-v3-turbo (~1.6 GB) is fast on Metal and much more accurate; plenty of headroom at 64 GB.
